role: Data Builder preparation report, not independent QA or inference result

sourcePreparation.newSourceScope: Two metadata-fixed +6second continuations of M3R city/stopped windows; same recording/domain, not cross-scene generalization

primaryReviewPreparation.formatProvenance: Unmodified generic M3Q review helper and format stamp, with new M3U clip IDs and source/input hashes
primaryReviewPreparation.warning: These previsual labels/boxes are not final scoring truth; root/reviewer must explicitly retain, correct or omit candidates before inference

secondaryReviewPreparation.sourceRule: Exact official instance histories used by unchanged radial trend: start/mid/current, each leg>=300ms, total<=950ms
secondaryReviewPreparation.metricScope: Pre-inference visible-box extent after pose rotation compensation; heuristic delta=max(3nativepx,.03*minimum side), not confidence interval or material-point groundtruth. ANY definitely contracting leg contradicts sustained two-leg expansion, not object moving away. Primary radial labels are never changed by secondary results.

authoredTests.type: Structural/authored geometry/transport tests, not model or road-quality evidence

testIntegrationNote: After M3U input creation, planning fixtures replay SHA-verified pre-M3U prior-input snapshot from the sealed plan; the frozen fetcher and actual preflight/source are unchanged. Fixture stdout captured and dated temporary directories automatically cleaned.
limits: No A/B, learned inference, phone, deployment, commit or push executed by this data task. Source/accounting/secondary review proposals are ready for independent review; no warning, metres or safety acceptance.
